title: Add CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_HEXDUMP Kconfig symbol
description: Add new Kconfig bool CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_HEXDUMP in lichen/Kconfig under diagnostics section. Default n. Help text: 'Enable hex dump of first 32 bytes on protocol parse failures. Increases flash usage. Enable for debugging only.' This gates the LOG_HEXDUMP_DBG calls added by sibling beads. Verify: Kconfig parses without errors.
